_comment: Instance data for core/scripts/claim-lint.py (run by core/scripts/brain-selftest.sh): where this brain keeps
its human-readable claim schema and in which words its claim blocks name the evidence method.
schema = path of the schema document, relative to the brain root (named in the report, skipped as a source
of blocks; a declared path that does not exist is a finding). Leave it empty when the brain has no own
document - the form in the lint's header and the core rule (rules/thinking-protocol.md rule 0) apply.
paths = where blocks are searched when the lint gets no path (default ["docs"]).
method_aliases = the brain's own words for the three methods measured | derived | assumed, e.g. for a Spanish
none_words = words that mean 'none' in the independence field, besides 'none'.
